newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-KPN extends TNT bid to December 3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-KPN extends TNT bid to December 3.

text.p: Dutch postal and telecoms firm Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV said on Monday it had extended the closing date of its friendly takeover bid for TNT Ltd to December 3.
The offers for TNT's ordinary and converting preference shares had previously been set to close on November 19.
KPN said its A$2.45 cash offer for each class of share will not be increased in the absence of a bid from a third party.
It said it now held 20.5 percent of TNT's ordinary shares and 20.4 percent of the converting stock.
